title: Robot vacuum brands respond to the FCC ban: See statements from Shark, iRobot, Eufy, and more
excerpt: I reached out to the impacted vacuum brands that I regularly test at home.
content_html:
Table of Contents

A recent FCC decision could severely stunt the growth of any list of the best robot vacuums that pops up on Google.

Top robot vacuum brands like Roborock and Dreame typically release new robot vacuums multiple times throughout the year. But the FCC's ban on foreign-made mobile robots, which includes robot vacuums, will prevent U.S. shoppers from buying any of them. No new Sharks, no new Roombas... the mainstream market would pretty much be swept.

The ban won't touch robot vacuums that are already in circulation. As is the case with foreign-made drones, exemptions are technically possible for future releases. Manufacturers could circumvent the ban by getting special approval from the government, which will decide whether or not their particular robot vacuums are a security threat.

You May Also Like

Hypothetically, it's hard for shoppers to conceptualize just how slim pickings could get. But how are the brands themselves taking the news? I reached out to the impacted robot vacuum brands that I regularly test at home. Here are the official statements given to Mashable via email so far:

“Our Shark robot vacuums currently sold in the U.S. will continue to be available for sale, use, and support. Regarding future models, we are evaluating our best options, but as a U.S.-based company we believe we are well positioned to navigate the process to continue to launch new models at competitive prices as we always have. We are closely monitoring developments and evaluating next steps as more information becomes available. We remain committed to serving our consumers and keeping them informed.”

Mashable Trend Report

Eufy

"We are aware of the FCC’s recent update. Based on our current understanding, the new rule does not affect the continued availability, use, or support of products we currently sell in the United States. Those products remain available and will continue to receive updates and customer support.

Like others across the industry, we are seeking further clarity on how the rule will be applied to future products, and we will keep our customers informed. We remain committed to complying with all regulatory requirements in every market where we operate."

iRobot

"We are aware of the FCC's recent action and are working with them to better understand its implementation and potential impact. We remain committed to serving our customers and will share updates as more information becomes available."

Narwal

"Narwal products already certified and sold in the United States are not affected by the FCC’s action. Our customers’ robots continue to work, remain fully supported, and current models remain available at retail. We are reviewing the announcement and the conditional approval process, and we remain committed to serving our U.S. consumers. The security and privacy of our customers’ homes is foundational to the ethos of the Narwal brand, and we welcome the opportunity to demonstrate that."

This story is developing and will be updated if more statements are received.

content_html_zh:
目录

FCC 最近的一项决定可能会严重阻碍谷歌上出现的最佳机器人吸尘器列表的增长。

Roborock 和 Dreame 等顶级扫地机器人品牌通常会在一年中多次发布新款扫地机器人。 但美国联邦通信委员会对外国制造的移动机器人（包括扫地机器人）的禁令将阻止美国消费者购买任何此类机器人。 没有新的 Sharks，没有新的 Roomba... 主流市场几乎会被席卷。

该禁令不会涉及已经流通的机器人吸尘器。 与外国制造的无人机一样，未来发布的产品在技术上也有可能获得豁免。 制造商可以通过获得政府的特别批准来规避禁令，政府将决定他们的特定机器人吸尘器是否构成安全威胁。

你可能也喜欢

假设而言，购物者很难想象可供选择的商品到底有多少。 但品牌本身如何看待这一消息呢？ 我联系了我经常在家测试的受影响的扫地机器人品牌。 以下是迄今为止通过电子邮件向 Mashable 发出的官方声明：

“我们目前在美国销售的 Shark 扫地机器人将继续销售、使用和支持。 关于未来的车型，我们正在评估我们的最佳选择，但作为一家美国公司，我们相信我们处于有利位置，能够像往常一样继续以有竞争力的价格推出新车型。 我们正在密切关注事态发展，并随着更多信息的出现评估后续步骤。 我们仍然致力于为消费者提供服务并让他们了解情况。”

可混搭趋势报告

Eufy

“我们了解 FCC 最近的更新。 根据我们目前的了解，新规则不会影响我们目前在美国销售的产品的持续可用性、使用或支持。 这些产品仍然可用，并将继续获得更新和客户支持。

与业内其他公司一样，我们正在寻求进一步明确该规则将如何应用于未来的产品，并且我们将随时向客户通报情况。 我们仍然致力于遵守我们经营所在每个市场的所有监管要求。”

爱机器人

“我们了解 FCC 最近的行动，并正在与他们合作，以更好地了解其实施情况和潜在影响。 我们仍然致力于为客户提供服务，并将随着更多信息的出现而分享最新信息。”

独角鲸

“已经在美国获得认证并销售的 Narwal 产品不受 FCC 行动的影响。 我们客户的机器人可以继续工作，仍然得到充分支持，并且当前型号仍然可以在零售店购买。 我们正在审查该公告和有条件批准程序，我们仍然致力于为美国消费者提供服务。 客户家庭的安全和隐私是 Narwal 品牌精神的基础，我们欢迎有机会证明这一点。”

这个故事正在发展中，如果收到更多声明，将会更新。
